info.title: pantsman
info.description: HTTP API for the pantsman Markov chainer bot. Generate nonsense sentences from the bot's corpus, feed it new text to learn from, and inspect the size of its Markov chain.

get.description: Generates a sentence by walking the Markov chain from a random starting word. Returns up to maxWords words; the walk may end early if it reaches a word with no known followers.

parameters.name: maxWords
parameters.description: Maximum number of words in the generated sentence. Defaults to the server's configured limit (30).

text.example: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

503.description: The corpus is empty, so nothing can be generated yet. Train the bot first via POST /train.

post.summary: Train the bot on new text
post.description: Feeds a piece of text into the Markov chain. Each adjacent word pair in the text is recorded as a possible transition. Training takes effect immediately for subsequent /generate calls.

text.description: The text to learn from. Split on whitespace; punctuation is kept as part of words.
text.example: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

204.description: The text was ingested into the chain.

400.description: The request body is missing a non-empty text field.

get.description: Reports the current size of the Markov chain: how many distinct words it knows and how many word-to-word transitions it has recorded.

words.description: Number of distinct words in the chain.

transitions.description: Total number of recorded word-to-word transitions.
